question: How many leap days has a single Norwegian mother given birth on?
answer: Three. Karin Henriksen had Heidi on 29 February 1960, Olav on 29 February 1964 and Leif-Martin on 29 February 1968. Any one birth has about a 1-in-1,461 chance of landing on a leap day, so three chosen births all doing so is about 1 in 3 billion. Guinness lists the family's record.
